# Sir Mark Boleat

Sir Mark Boleat has participated in 1 election since 2002:

- [**2022 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/mark-boleat#e48)

  Not elected.

  - [2022 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2022/sir-mark-boleat/)
  - [2022 Vote.je Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=p3GWenUS9jI)

Sir Mark Boleat has declared his intention to stand in the upcoming [2026 Senators Election](https://flow.je/elections/2026). \[[jerseyeveningpost.com](https://jerseyeveningpost.com/news/2026/03/31/former-city-of-london-political-lead-to-stand-for-senator/)\]
